systems.platform: DHIS2 with the DHIS2 Android application
systems.owner: RTI International with the Ministry of Public Health's DSNIS and Directorate of Disease Surveillance and the Haut Katanga Provincial Health Office, funded by US CDC
systems.tiers: 235 responsible health centres and hospitals in 15 of 27 health zones of Haut Katanga enter on tablets (from October 2022); health zone data managers enter for the other 12 zones (from March 2023)
health facilities, weekly reports and immediate case reports

note: Everything described is disease surveillance (weekly epidemiological reports and case notification), a single function, so it gives no hmis fact. The document says the eIDSR sits in the national DHIS2 platform, used nationally, but does not describe that platform's routine reporting.
